name: Dumbbell Incline Bench Single-Arm Preacher Curl
steps: Set an adjustable bench to a steep incline and stand behind the backrest holding a dumbbell palms up.
Rest the back of that upper arm flat against the sloping pad with your armpit snug at the top.
Bend your elbow to curl the dumbbell toward your shoulder, then lower it nearly straight under control.
Complete the working arm, then switch sides and repeat.
tips: Keep the entire back of your upper arm planted against the backrest.
Avoid leaning over the bench or snapping your elbow straight at the bottom.
